title: helpful/unhelpful feedback reorders real search results
description: Proves the full feedback loop end-to-end: rating one fact `helpful` and an equally-relevant rival `unhelpful` moves their trust scores and, through the trust-weighted combined_score, flips their order in the real fact_store search tool. This is the payoff the feedback instruction (surfaced in tracedecay_context and the digest) is meant to produce.
contract_notes: Deterministic, no LLM. Two facts share every query-matching token and seed at trust 0.7. A helpful step (+0.05) lifts fact_id=1 to 0.75; an unhelpful step (-0.10) drops fact_id=2 to 0.60. Both stay above the default min-trust floor, and the 0.75-vs-0.60 trust gate makes the praised fact rank first. Assertions run after the well-behaved feedback steps.

facts.content: Checkout service validates coupons against the promo ledger tango
Checkout service validates coupons against the promo ledger foxtrot

assertions.name: helpful_raised_praised_trust
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_facts WHERE source = 'praised' AND trust_score > 0.7

assertions.name: unhelpful_lowered_panned_trust
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_facts WHERE source = 'panned' AND trust_score < 0.65
